message: Field "Post.search" constructor "Raw" Authoring helper argument at Raw[0] is invalid: A raw type is one type name as the database catalog prints it, such as tsvector, double precision, geometry(Point,4326), app.email or "MyType"[]: words of letters, digits and underscores separated by single spaces, or double-quoted names with each double quote inside doubled; the first optionally after one schema name and a dot; each optionally followed by parentheses holding only letters, digits, underscores, commas, spaces and a minus sign before a digit; and at most one trailing [].
